evidence.reason: The current tip already implements the proposed fallback: the establishing hook assigns acpSessionId from establishingRequestedId when the response has no sessionId. That handles spec-compliant load/resume responses and lets same-chunk post-response updates pass the session-id gate. The resume-id fix is in commit 29a9e0c31ee9b9ab82c853d3f66bb2704c1afa36.
